1.web: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.
1.asv: We give thanks unto thee, O God; We give thanks, for thy name is near: Men tell of thy wondrous works.

2.web: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.
2.asv: When I shall find the set time, I will judge uprightly.

3.web: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.
3.asv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I have set up the pillars of it. [Selah

4.web: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.
4.asv: I said unto the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly; And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

5.web: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”
5.asv: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not with a stiff neck.

6.web: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.
6.asv: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the south, cometh lifting up.

7.web: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
7.asv: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.

8.web: For in the hand of Yahweh there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.
8.asv: For in the hand of Jehovah there is a cup, and the wine foameth; It is full of mixture, and he poureth out of the same: Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.

9.web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
9.asv: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

10.web: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
10.asv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
